authenticity_review: The image demonstrates strong photorealism with coherent lighting, depth of field, and environmental context. These are severity-1/2 issues that do not compromise overall recognition or scene coherence. Pose auditor reports low artifact risk (22% low-confidence keypoints, concentrated in occluded hind limbs), supporting structural integrity. No melting, impossible anatomy, or semantic errors detected. Authenticity remains high but not flawless due to these localized imperfections.
